primitives.meaning: attributed attention to an item, category or search that meets the company's qualification rule for interest - repeated, recent, and not followed by a selection or a process
entryFilters: the attention is attributed to a person we may contact - not a bot, not an unattributed session
the attention meets the company's qualification rule (interest.qualification_rule): repeated, recent, and on something the person could act on
no selection, order or process exists for the item or category since the attention
the item or category is currently available as the platform asserts it
no interest instance is already open for this person and interest key
purpose-level permission for commercial recovery communication is recorded, and hard gates (GLB-31) allow it

primitives.asks: Does this attention qualify as interest, and is it still unresolved?

branches.label: Qualified and unresolved
branches.observes: interest signal, selection and process records, availability, permission record
branches.test: the qualification rule is met, no selection, order or process followed, the subject is available, permission is recorded and no instance is open

branches.label: Already resolved
branches.test: a selection, order or process for the subject exists since the attention

branches.label: Does not qualify
branches.test: the rule is not met, the subject is unavailable or already held, or permission is absent - the reason is recorded

primitives.does: Open the interest instance against the person and interest key and start the clock from the last attention. Further attention before the touch moves the clock; nothing after it extends any window

cancelOn.meaning: a selection is recorded against the person in the system of record without a process being started
an authoritative record that a resumable process (checkout, application, quote, registration) opened for a person with at least one item and a resumable state
an authoritative purchase for the person, on any subject

primitives.reads: the interest re-read: still no selection, order or process for the subject; the subject still available; the person still contactable

primitives.asks: Is the interest still unresolved, and is its subject still there?

branches.label: Unresolved, subject available
branches.test: no selection, order or process followed and the platform asserts the subject as available

branches.label: Resolved meanwhile
branches.test: a selection, order or process for the subject was recorded

branches.label: Subject gone
branches.test: the platform now asserts the subject as unavailable

branches.label: Sendable
branches.test: the send path passes: permission for commercial recovery, a deliverable destination, the promotional pressure cap, no higher-precedence contest on the person, and no cooldown in force

branches.label: Suppressed
branches.test: a gate stops it; the gate is recorded as the reason

primitives.does: Record why nothing was sent - not qualified, unavailable, already held, no permission, or a gate on the send path - so that no-action, the common outcome here, is a measured one

competition.precedence: lowest in the group - a process in motion, a held selection and a predicted need all outrank an inferred interest for the same person

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: an app session or a valid push token exists for this person - the attention is recent and a route back beats content
no low-friction route exists, or the touch has to carry the thing looked at and survive until the person can act

primitives.purpose: The thing they looked at, as it stands now, and a route back to it. Nothing about stock, price or intent that the system does not assert.
primitives.brief: Show the thing they looked at as it stands now and give a route back to it. Claim nothing the system does not assert: no reserved stock, no held price, no discount, and no assumption about what they meant

mustNotClaim: that they meant to buy it

primitives.label: RECOMMENDED_DEFAULT

an authoritative record that a resumable process (checkout, application, quote, registration) opened for a person with at least one item and a resumable state
an authoritative purchase for the person, on any subject

primitives.reads: selection, order and process records re-read for the subject

primitives.state: resolved; a selection, process or purchase for the subject is recorded and its own journey owns it
primitives.reEntry: a new interest key is a new interest

primitives.state: the subject became unavailable; nothing is sent about something the person cannot act on
primitives.reEntry: a new interest key is a new interest

primitives.state: no touch sent; the reason is recorded - the common outcome of this journey
primitives.reEntry: the same interest key re-qualifying inside the cooldown is the same interest; a new key is a new interest

primitives.state: touched once, not resolved; nothing further is sent
primitives.reEntry: a new interest key is a new interest, and enters silently while the cooldown runs
